name: Artistry Oracle Mystery
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the artistry mystery adds Bluff, Disguise, Knowledge (nobility), and Perform to their list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: 2nd–play instrument, 4th–minor image, 6th–major image, 8th-majestic image, 10th–joyful rapture, 12th–irresistible dance, 14th–waves of ecstasy, 16th–scintillating pattern, 18th-resplendent mansion

Revelations: An oracle with the artistry mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Bardic Performance: You can add your mystery to your performing ability. You can add 1/2 your oracle levels to your effective levels for determining the power, rounds and performances available in bardic performance.

You must already have bardic performance from another class to take this revelation.

Behind the Mask (Su)

While you are wearing a costume or under the effects of disguise self or alter self, you gain a +2 bonus on Will saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects. Once per day at 7th level, you can re-roll a Will saving throw against a mind-affecting effect and choose the more favorable result. At 11th level, the bonus on Will saving throws increases to +4.

Charming Presence (Sp)

As a standard action, you can use your charming nature to turn enemies into friends. You may use charm person, as the spell, on one target within 30 feet. The save DC for this effect is the oracle save DC instead of the spell DC. This effect lasts for a number of minutes equal to your oracle level. At 14th level, this becomes charm monster. This is a mind-affecting, language dependent effect and the target must be able to see you.

Costume (Sp)

You can change your appearance at will, as disguise self with a caster level equal to your oracle level. At 7th level, you can instead physically transform, as alter self. At 11th level, this ability lasts until you dismiss it or use it again, allowing you to keep it active while you sleep.

Focus on Aesthetics (Ex)

You have an innate knack for style and form. You use your Charisma modifier instead of your Intelligence modifier for Craft and Artistry checks. Additionally you gain a +1 bonus on those checks. This bonus increases by 1 at 5th level and every 5 levels after 5th.

Insight into Desire (Sp)

As a standard action, you can learn the desires of any creature you can see within 100 feet, as if you had concentrated until the third round of the spell detect desires. As usual for detect desires, the target can attempt a Will save to negate the effect. You can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and for every 5 levels beyond 5th.

Nimble Dancer (Ex)

Your base speed increases by 10 feet. At 5th level, you receive Nimble Moves as a bonus feat. At 10th level, you receive Acrobatic Steps as a bonus feat. You do not need to meet the prerequisites to receive these feats. Oracles with the lame oracle curse cannot select this revelation.

Once More with Gusto (Ex)

Once per day, you can reattempt any previously failed Craft, Artistry or Perform check. On this attempt, you gain a +10 competence bonus on the check.

Performative Magic (Su)

Your experience with performance and its ties to magic has granted you the ability to cast bard spells as if they were on your spell list. Once per day, you can cast a spell from the bard spell list as if it were on your list of spells known. This spell consumes a slot of one level higher than the level of the spell. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Story Keeper (Ex)

Instead of encyclopedic knowledge, you learn most of your information through tales, songs, and poems. You may use your Charisma modifier instead of your Intelligence modifier on all Knowledge checks.

Final Revelation (Su)

At 20th level, you become an avatar of emotional experience. You receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. Additionally, you become immune to fear and despair effects and can ignore any emotion effect you do not wish to benefit or suffer from. As a standard action, you can remove all emotion, fear, or despair effects with a touch. On a successful touch you roll a dispel attempt (as the spell dispel magic) using your oracle level as your caster level to dispel the emotion, fear or despair effect. You may use this dispelling touch at will.
